extracted.intended_audience: Catholic children and learners; catechism students and teachers
extracted.subtask_description: A chapter from a Catholic catechism explaining prayers (Apostles' Creed, Confiteor, Acts of Faith/Hope/Love/Contrition), basic doctrines (Trinity, Incarnation, Resurrection), and moral instruction intended for learners. It is instructional religious material rather than a production or evaluation rubric.
